nodes.label: NVMe-oF (NVMe over Fabrics) RDMA Disaggregated Storage Fabric
nodes.description: Kernel-bypass disaggregated storage transport protocol leveraging RoCEv2 and InfiniBand for remote NVMe SSD block access with near-local latency in high-throughput graph processing.

nodes.label: AQMAR Arabic Part-of-Speech and Named Entity Corpus Engine
nodes.description: Domain-adapted morphological POS tagger and entity annotator trained on the American University in Cairo AQMAR corpus for dialectal and specialized Arabic NLP pipelines.

nodes.label: IETF RFC 8554 LMS/HSS Stateful Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
nodes.description: Leighton-Micali Hash-Based Signatures (LMS) and Hierarchical Signature System (HSS) specification for post-quantum cryptographic authentication of immutable graph blocks.

nodes.label: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) Proximity Graph Vector Search
nodes.description: Multi-layer graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search algorithm providing sub-linear query time for high-dimensional cross-lingual embedding vectors in GraphRAG.

nodes.label: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 & 27701:2019 Information Security & Privacy Governance Standard
nodes.description: International standards governing Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) and Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS) for secure sovereign data operations.
